name: CA-17
label: Safe D

key_factors: D+21 district lean with two-term incumbent Ro Khanna running
Massive fundraising gap: Khanna has $16.9M on hand vs. Tandon's $891
Prediction markets price Khanna at ~97% to win
model.rationale: Khanna holds a deep-blue Silicon Valley seat with a huge cash advantage, while Tandon has raised almost nothing and markets price this as effectively decided. The fundamentals support a Safe D rating with a margin in the mid-20s.
model.watch: Any sign of meaningful Republican spending or polling showing a tighter race would warrant revisiting, but no such evidence exists.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Ro Khanna seeks another term in a Silicon Valley district that leans about 21 points Democratic. He enters the general with roughly $16.9 million on hand after raising more than $13 million, while Republican Ritesh Tandon has raised under $38,000 and reports under $1,000 in cash. No outside groups are meaningfully engaged, and no public polling of the race is available.

Prediction markets give Khanna about a 97 percent chance of winning, and the district's fundamentals point to a comfortable margin in the mid-20s. With no credible evidence of a competitive race, this sits firmly in Safe D territory.
